Name: Island and Waterfront Homes
H1 Description: Method is experienced in building in remote island and waterfront environments, including the San Juan Islands, Bainbridge Island, and the islands of British Columbia.
Paragraph Description: Island and remote construction can present specific challenges and expenses. Method Homes is familiar with the complexities of working on waterfront and island locations and we have expertise in assessing modular access to island locations, designing for waterfront and steep-sloped landscapes, accommodating to local building codes, and delivering modules and materials via ferries and barges. Prefab building naturally lends itself to building on small infill, steep-sloped, and remotely located landscapes. Since we construct much of each home off–site, we are able to reduce on-site work, which saves costs on local labor and minimizes disruption to your neighbors.

Name: Mountain Modern Homes
H1 Description: Method Homes has experience in building modern modular homes in a vast range of mountainous locations such as Lake Tahoe, the Tetons, and Sun Valley, ID.
Paragraph Description:
Mountain construction requires a particular set of expertise and Method Homes is sure to deliver. Method is familiar with building on slopes, designing for high snow loads, and accessing remote locations. We have a range of projects in mountain locations, from compact cabins to luxury estates in Martis Valley. 

Our prefab modular building process allows us to construct the majority of each home off-site, providing you with an expedited timeline and cost savings on local labor. We have experience designing and building on steep sloped landscapes and working to integrate your surrounding landscape and climate into the design of the home, ensuring it will be both beautiful and durable for years to come.

Name: Valley and Vineyard Homes
H1 Description: Method Homes has experience building in beautiful valley, vineyard, and peninsula settings, in places such as the Bay Area and Napa Valley.
Paragraph Description: In these projects, we work to maximize your view of the surrounding landscape and create ample opportunities for indoor-outdoor living. We are experienced in the complexities of slope stabilization and energy efficient design. Our prefab construction process allows us to build most of your home off-site, meaning we can build more efficiently and with less disruption to your site and neighbors. We are able to do site preparation concurrently with off-site construction of the modules, expediting the timeline of the build up to 60% faster than a traditional build.

Name: City and Urban
H1 Description: Method Homes has built in a variety of city and urban environments such as Seattle, WA, Jackson, WY, and Portland, OR.
Paragraph Description: Building in an urban environment requires certain considerations. Method knows how to make efficient use of tight spaces and create a peaceful atmosphere in the middle of a busy urban environment. We understand the importance of maximizing views without compromising privacy and have a proven track record of building homes in an urban setting that feel private and serene. Our off-site construction process allows us to build high quality, healthy homes on a quicker timeline and with less disruption to your neighbors. Prefab is great for building and making an efficient use of tight urban infill lots.
